description: This file defines the 'AuthHandler' interface for authentication handling within the Eclipse Hono device service project. It specifies methods for parsing credentials, authenticating devices, and retrieving the authentication provider, tailored to execution contexts.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Parses credentials from the execution context into a JsonObject suitable for authentication.

methods.name: authenticateDevice
methods.description: Performs authentication of a device based on the execution context.

methods.name: getAuthProvider
methods.description: Returns the authorization provider used for credential validation.
